definitions.A_t: log p_T(y_t|h_t) - log pi_c(y_t|h_t), label teacher of the prompt's domain, detached
definitions.L_d_response_mean: -(1/R_d) sum_r (1/T_r) sum_t A_t log pi_theta(y_t|h_t)  (trainer's sample-mean)
definitions.g_d: full-parameter gradient of L_d at theta = c over all language-model parameters (vision frozen); importance ratio 1 so PPO clipping is inactive; no gradient clipping; no optimizer
definitions.combined: G = sum_d a_d g_d with a_d = (n_d/N) w_d; n_d = responses of domain d (equal here)
definitions.contribution_share: a_d <g_d, G> / ||G||^2 (sums to 1; can be negative)
definitions.dn_probe_weights: clip(sigma_all / sigma_d, 0.25, 4), population std of A_t over all valid probe tokens of this checkpoint (sigma_all pooled over the three domains)
definitions.split_half: prompts of each domain alternately assigned to halves 0/1 (16 prompts x 4 responses each); within-domain half cosine = sampling-consistency reference for cross-domain cosines; noise-corrected quantities replace ||g_d||^2 by <g_d0, g_d1>
definitions.coord_proxy: per-coordinate reading of the weighted combination (a first-Adam-step / sign proxy): dominant_share = fraction of coordinates (with G_i != 0) where domain d has the largest |a_d g_d,i|; sign_agree = fraction where sign(a_d g_d,i) == sign(G_i); l1_share = sum_i |a_d g_d,i| / sum_i sum_e |a_e g_e,i|. Not the steady-state Adam update
definitions.response_concentration: top-k share of sum_r ||h_r/T_r||^2 (response-mean) or sum_r ||h_r||^2 (token-mean), h_r = per-response gradient; ignores cross terms
